key_points: Aon completes $17B acquisition of USI Insurance Services, its second major middle-market deal in two years
Creates self-described 'premier U.S. middle-market platform' with significant scale
Executive changes announced effective Nov 16, 2026 alongside deal close
Multiple institutional investors adding positions (Teachers Retirement KY, HighTower, Hantz Financial)
Integration execution and synergy realization will drive thesis over coming quarters
